$comment: Paired critique evals: the reviewer sees one side of a pair (sheet, sync report, liveness report where named, and context with the side's threads and ledger lines), never expect.json. Shots are 3 s at 10 fps: s01 0-29, s02 30-59, s03 60-89, s04 90-119. Sheets come from build-sheets.sh.

off-beat-sfx.damaged: dimension 7; the s02 whoosh peaks at frame 32 (2 frames late); the tick for s04's frame 90 peaks at frame 87, in s03, on the edge of mix's 3-frame search window (not found)
off-beat-sfx.context: Logline: a launch title card system in four beats. Look: asymmetric editorial, one orange accent. Same stills on both sides; only the sound differs.

default-look.damaged: dimension 1 (film) and 5 in every shot: one centered box on a flat field
default-look.context: Logline: a launch title card system in four beats. Look: asymmetric editorial, one orange accent.

slideshow-pace.damaged: dimension 2 (film) and 3 in every shot: four unrelated still slides, each held 3 s; its liveness report fails every limit

bad.threads: Seam threads: s01 -> s02, s02 -> s03 and s03 -> s04 beat-cut-thread (the cut lands on the beat).

good.threads: Seam threads: s01 -> s02, s02 -> s03 and s03 -> s04 shared-element-thread (the white title bar and its orange accent line move to their next position). An orange marker travels along the top edge through the whole film.

slideshow-pace.context: Logline: a launch title card system in four beats. Look: asymmetric editorial, one orange accent. Shots start at global frames 0, 30, 60 and 90. No seam strips and no clip ship: the liveness report was measured on the full-rate film as a lone video, so it names no cuts; a seam inside a still span over 0.5 s is frozen, and a seam outside every still span moved at the report's 12 fps sampling.

effect-stack.damaged: dimension 4 in s02, frames 30-59: six stacked flashing boxes and a strobe over the subject
effect-stack.context: Logline: a launch title card system in four beats. Look: asymmetric editorial, one orange accent.

data-story.damaged: dimension 6 in s01-s03: the bar values have no source and the axis has no zero label

bad.ledger: bar values typed by hand; no source, no retrieval date

good.ledger: bar values from a public city temperature dataset, retrieved 2026-09-01; axis starts at zero

data-story.context: Non-product data story. Look: data-journalism (motion-look), adapted to a dark field with one orange accent. Logline: the third city warmed fastest. The highlighted bar in s03 is the third city; s04 is the end card with the claim. An orange year marker travels along the bottom edge through the whole film. Seam threads: s01 -> s02 shared-element-thread (the four bars); s02 -> s03 shared-element-thread (the third city's bar); s03 -> s04 shared-element-thread (the orange accent, from the callout to the end-card line). Shots start at global frames 0, 30, 60 and 90. No seam strips and no clip ship: the liveness report was measured on the full-rate film as a lone video, so it names no cuts; a seam inside a still span over 0.5 s is frozen, and a seam outside every still span moved at the report's 12 fps sampling.
